rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that exists but has not yet become visible or developed.

example.english: This plan still has many latent problems that may not be immediately apparent.
example.traditional: 呢個計劃仲有好多潛在問題，未必即刻睇得出。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 cim4 zoi6 man6 tai4 mei6 bit1 zik1 hak1 tai2 dak1 ceot1

rows.note: Use this when something is actually lying hidden or dormant, especially a virus or infection.

example.english: This virus can remain latent in the body for a long time without any symptoms.
example.traditional: 呢種病毒可以喺身體入面潛伏好耐，完全冇病徵。
example.jyutping: ne1 zung2 beng6 duk6 ho2 ji5 hai2 san1 tai2 jap6 min6 cim4 fuk6 hou2 noi6 jyun4 cyun4 mou5 beng6 zing1

rows.note: Use this mainly in medical contexts for an infection or condition that is present without being apparent.

example.english: The examination showed that they have a latent infection, but currently no symptoms.
example.traditional: 檢查顯示佢帶有隱性感染，但目前冇任何病徵。
example.jyutping: gim2 caa4 hin2 si6 keoi5 daai3 jau5 jan2 sing3 gam2 jim5 daan6 muk6 cin4 mou5 jam6 ho4 beng6 zing1
